events.text: JoshMemory Record: Fixed ashfaller PR contamination. Preserved old lint commit locally on branch preserve/ashfaller-lint-fixes. Created new branch security/pin-actions-clean from main and cherry-picked only the security commit (c7406d3). Pushed and created PR #2, closed old PR #1. Verified AIDungeonMaster PR #7 CI failure is definitively caused by a pre-existing linting issue on main. Verified AvanceProfessionalDevelopment PR #3 is a completely clean 1-file diff and ready to merge. Updated SecurityAudit register and parser to track these final states.
